title: 129th Rescue Wing Year-in-Review 2013
description: In 2013, the 129th Rescue Wing reaches 1,000 saves as it deploys Airmen to Afghanistan and Djibouti and battles wildfires throughout California.  Other highlights include an overwater rescue of a Norwegian cruise line passenger, deactivation of the 561st Air Force Band, a visit from the Secretary of Defense, and a Family Day picnic. Available in High Definition.
